task.description: The address of the task group, for example @v1/nuucognition/taskgroup/<id>#ops. For a new task group, give no input, and set it after Stage 1 with flint shard invocations set-input <id> task=<address>.

steps.title: Task Group
steps.next: Read the task group with ops task group show --json, or make it with ops task group create. Read each task, and choose the order. For a new task group, set the input: flint shard invocations set-input {{invocation}} task=<address>.

steps.title: Pin
steps.next: Pin the task group: flint orbh task pin {{task}}. Check the TASK line with flint orbh task show.

next.interactive: Do the tasks of {{task}} one at a time. Record each commit on its own task: with ops task commit for a task.dev, in the result for an untyped task. Write its result, set built for a task.dev, run flint shard task task-sync on it, and close each task alone when it can close.
next.headless: Set the phase implementing. Do the tasks of {{task}} one at a time, and keep the progress current. Record each commit on its own task: with ops task commit for a task.dev, in the result for an untyped task. Write its result, set built for a task.dev, and run flint shard task task-sync on it.

next.interactive: Give the person a summary of each task, and the review_task command of each task.dev at built. Then close the invocation: flint shard invocations close {{invocation}} --outcome done.
next.headless: Set the phase complete. Close the invocation: flint shard invocations close {{invocation}} --outcome done. Put the summary of each task and each review_task command in the result. When no parent frame is open, return with flint orbh session return --finish. When the close prints back in: (a parent frame is open), do not return: continue the parent frame.

behaviours.say: Pin the task group before the first edit: flint orbh task pin {{task}}
The input task is empty: no task group is recorded. Set it with flint shard invocations set-input {{invocation}} task=<address>, or close the invocation with --outcome abandoned.
